curated-gf-libertinus-keyboard-fs-nunito: Distinctive, that's Libertinus Keyboard, with lowercase towering like pylons. Nunito, a sans-serif with open terminals and big round bowls, counters those pinched curls; closed against open is the whole trick, good for a couple of lines.
curated-gf-libertinus-keyboard-gf-jaldi: Towering lowercase marches like pylons through Libertinus Keyboard, curls pinched shut. Jaldi, a plain sans with brushed, tightly packed letters, would tire the eye over page after page, though fine on, say, a cycling team kit.
